subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin expose only opt-in, sanitized authorized call-activity events, and if so which statuses and retention semantics are permitted for agent use?
rationale: The implementation can subscribe to Baileys mechanically, but maintainers must choose the privacy, consent, retention, and agent-tool/session contract for sensitive call metadata.

options.title: Ship minimal opt-in activity events
options.body: Expose only selected authorized call states after existing inbound access checks, with no implicit durable call history unless a separately documented state contract is approved.

options.title: Defer call activity collection
options.body: Keep the current message-only inbound contract until a broader relationship-history and retention policy is defined.

recommendation.title: Ship minimal opt-in activity events
recommendation.body: Expose only selected authorized call states after existing inbound access checks, with no implicit durable call history unless a separately documented state contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior review set the WhatsApp-plugin ownership and access-control boundary that this decision extends.
